snippet.title: Create your OWN Mario 64 levels! [Mario Builder 64 v1.1 RELEASE]
snippet.description:
Download Mario Builder 64 here! https://gamebanana.com/mods/514361

After a year of development, the new Mario Builder 64 version is RELEASED! This update has a HUGE changelog and adds a bunch of new features, QoL improvements, bug fixes and general polish.

Mario Builder 64 is a SM64 ROM hack created by myself and Rovertronic. It functions as an easy-to-use level editor and player for SM64 levels, functioning similar to Mario Maker. It even supports saving levels to files and loading other people's levels, so sharing levels is easy, and works on a real Nintendo 64.

Join the official Mario Builder 64 Discord! https://discord.gg/4qt2DP4Dyy
